neighbours.label: An abstract noun that will take 'of' + a gerund ('the process of', 'the act of', 'the challenge of', 'the experience of'), firing on the noun; 'act' as a law or play section, and those nouns without that complement, stay lower.
fire: It was the slow process of rebuilding the bridge.
The simple act of walking calms me.
Many parents face the challenge of raising kids alone.
Nothing beats the experience of hiking at dawn.
She began the difficult task of sorting the letters.
He regrets the mistake of trusting them.
We went through the long process of applying for visas.
The physical act of writing helps memory.
quiet: It was a slow day at the bridge.
The Patriot Act was signed in 2001.
Many parents like the park near the school.
The hike was great and we went back.
She finished the letters on her desk.
He regrets the trip to Paris.
We went through the long tunnel near the border.
The second act of the opera was short.

notes: The output direction suppresses ' act', ' of', ' process', ' task'. Probes: 0.15-0.68 on the frame. 'The process was slow' reached 0.29, so the noun alone leaks.
